name: Sference
description: The managed inference platform for open-weight models, fine-tunes, and distilled models. Low-latency realtime inference on European GPUs behind a single OpenAI-compatible API, independently measured as the fastest route on the models we serve, with priority, flex, and 24h batch tiers on the same endpoints. Serverless per-token to dedicated deployments. Full logging and audit trail, pinned model versions. Built and run in Europe.
